lead.title: MMI raises $125M Series D led by BioStar Capital to scale its Symani microsurgery robot
lead.deck: Angelini Ventures and S3 Ventures join the round; Symani is CE-marked, won FDA De Novo in 2024 and has about 50 systems installed for ~3,500 procedures. Proceeds fund commercial rollout, energy instruments and the REMIND trial (deep cervical lymph node drainage in neurodegenerative disease).

milestone.title: Argus Cognitive wins FDA clearance for Neurora, an AI tool supporting paediatric autism diagnosis
milestone.summary: Neurora, a Class II software as a medical device (SaMD), analyses 100+ vocal, facial and gaze biometrics from a behavioural assessment video (children aged 18 months to 12 years). Developed with an NIH SBIR grant.
milestone.why: Autism diagnosis is bottlenecked by specialist shortages; an FDA-cleared SaMD shows AI can slot into the clinical pathway as decision support, not as a standalone diagnosis.

brefsEurope.title: Convatec plans to expand its Boston R&D site by 50% and open a Manchester facility
brefsEurope.summary: CEO Jonny Mason leans on a $1B, ten-year US/UK R&D plan, eight product launches planned for 2026-2027 and a 6-8% sales growth target next year. A market comparable, not an entry opportunity.

brefsIntl.title: BD hits the primary endpoint at nine months in the AGILITY trial of the Revello covered stent
brefsIntl.summary: 120 patients at 28 sites (including Europe): 2.8% primary failure vs a 19% goal, 97.2% primary patency. The stent is CE-marked and investigational-only in the US.

brefsIntl.title: Epicore teams with MECFA on a wearable sweat-chloride sensor for cystic fibrosis
brefsIntl.summary: The Chloride Tracker combines sweat stimulation and chloride sensing in one connected patch; clinical evaluation will run at Marmara University (Istanbul).

brefsIntl.title: SurGenTec signs exclusive licence with Allevion Medical for the Vantage lumbar decompression system
brefsIntl.summary: A sterile, single-use system for minimally invasive lumbar decompression (stenosis), with integrated illumination and depth-controlled bone resection.

word.definition: Suturing vessels under 0.8 mm (e.g. lymphatics) with a robot that filters hand tremor and scales down the surgeon's motion for extreme precision.

how.t: The surgeon's movements are scaled down to the micrometre range.
The robot removes physiological hand tremor.
Instruments suture tiny vessels, e.g. a lymphovenous anastomosis (LVA) against lymphedema.

word.why: VC angle: a niche market with no established standard (2025 reviews show 97-100% initial patency, but 66.6% vs 81.8% at 12 months for robotic vs manual LVA), and MMI's $125M round validates the capital need.
